summary: RptMnuInvoicing is a report menu user control for generating CSV-based invoicing reports based on user-selected parameters. It gathers report filters, builds context headers, and invokes stored procedures to retrieve and output invoice data. The control supports flexible filtering by agency, department, program, term, cohort/course, placement request type, site, invoice status, and date ranges. The control handles saving and restoring filter states, validates required fields, and adapts UI elements based on user context (receiving/placing mode).
purpose: To enable users to generate customized invoicing reports by selecting relevant educational placement parameters, statuses, and date ranges. It streamlines the report creation, validation, and retrieval process for invoicing workflows within an educational placement management system.

workflows.name: Invoicing Report Generation
steps: Load saved filters and initialize UI controls
User selects parameters: agency, department, program, term/date, placement type, site, invoice status
Validate required fields (e.g. start/end date, cohort/course selection)
Save user filter selections for reuse
Build report header/context string based on selections
Invoke stored procedure ReportInvoicingCSV with parameters for term/date, agency, department, program, term, cohort, course, placement type, site, invoice status flags, inclusion options
Fetch report data and render CSV output
Display report HTML in UI and allow download/export

workflows.name: Filter Saving and Restoration
steps: Save each filter field to UserReportFilters with current values
On load or pre-render, restore filter states from UserReportFilters and update UI accordingly

workflows.name: Dropdown Population
steps: Populate dropdown lists for agencies, departments, programs, terms, sites, placement types, governing orgs based on user session and mode (receiving/placing)
Select previously saved or default values

business_rules: Agency, Department, Program, Term dropdowns are populated based on user permissions and selection context
Receiving mode restricts available agencies to user's own agency
Placing mode restricts dropdown to user's agency (except for PA dropdown, which may include ALL depending on mode)
Saved filters are restored on page load for easier repeat report creation
Term mode requires at least one cohort/course selection; Date mode requires valid start/end dates
PRType selection: 'All' disables controls and clears ID list
IncludeOption governs which placement requests are included: 0=confirmed, 1=accepted/confirmed, 2=all except declined/cancelled
validations: Start date required in date mode
End date required in date mode
At least one cohort/course required in term mode
PRTypeIDList cannot be empty unless 'All' is checked
Maximum cohort/courses selected cannot exceed system-defined limit (PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS)
calculations: Splitting CohortCourseIDList into CohortIDList and CourseIDList for report parameters
Header context string generation for report
conditions: termMode: determines if report is filtered by academic term or by date range
ReceivingMode: alters filter availability and dropdown content
IncludeOption: selects scope of included placement requests
invoiceStatusX flags: filters report by status (None, Sent, Validated, Paid, PaymentReceived)
system_behavior: UI controls dynamically enable/disable and show/hide based on filter context and mode
Filtered dropdowns and lists update based on dependencies (agency, department, program, term)
Filters are persisted and restored for consistent user experience
CSV report is generated server-side and rendered as HTML for download/export
dependencies: Dropdown population depends on prior filter/selection values and user session context
Report output depends on stored procedure (ReportInvoicingCSV) and provided parameters
Filter saving and restoration depend on UserReportFilters subsystem
exceptions: No courses selected in term mode prevents report generation
Missing start or end date in date mode prevents report generation
Too many cohort/courses selected triggers error and prevents report
content_gaps: No business logic details for stored procedures (ReportInvoicingCSV, ReportInvoicingCSVContext)
Limited description of report output structure and CSV formatting
